components.name: Chamfered terrace corner platform
components.function: Missing roof garden substrate and court/wing interface sections; use terrace images as component inspiration
components.construction: One isolated chamfered terrace corner platform as ivory/rose marble roof-terrace substrate, source curved/angled edges, visibly supported underside, square connection at rear to wing; no generic garden scene, trees/railings/fountains separate. Keep source courtyard scale and parapet heights human-compatible.
components.attachment_face: Underside/root to ground or declared host; keep true openings clear
components.semantic_front: Main visible face +Y and Zup; sides are actual thickness, not flattened painting
applies_to: Base, wall bodies and stepped wings
components.design_basis: Visible source vocabulary with missing construction views or new habitat forms; metrics and hidden surfaces proposed
